environment.connector: node scripts/studio-mcp.mjs over stdio, all 4 scopes, own tab; Windows 11 local machine

checks.name: Finer-mesh structural result produced in real Chrome (analysis-demo, #mesh-size 1.0 mm)
checks.detail: Solve 6.3 s at 1.0 mm; 1.5 mm solved in 2.0 s; 0.8 mm refused with "Element limit exceeded; increase mesh size" (so ~1.0 mm is the practical lower bound of the page). One saved case is 8,477,632 bytes of archive (versus ~1.4 MB for two earlier small cases); a 1.5 mm case archive was 2,757,728 bytes.

checks.name: Saving 8 large cases: not achieved; 4 saved
checks.detail: caseSave of cases 1-4 succeeded (about 2.7 s for the first). Saves of cases 5-8 each returned "Browser command timed out; inspect state before retrying" and a later caseList (itself 10.8 s with 4 large cases) still showed 4 cases; a separate retry of case 5 also timed out after ~15 s with no case added. 8 x 8.48 MB = about 68 MB would be below the 100,000,000-byte transfer cap, so the limiting factor observed here is the per-command timeout of the connector/page, not the transfer cap.

checks.name: caseArchiveExport of 4 large cases, chunked read, hash
checks.detail: 4 cases, 33910459 bytes, 518 chunks of up to 65536 bytes; assembled SHA-256 equals the declared hash; freeze (caseArchiveExport call) 10345 ms; reading all chunks 519183 ms (about 1.0 s per chunk, constant across the run); total 530714 ms (8.8 min); throughput about 0.062 MiB/s

checks.name: Page reload then caseArchiveImport + Write x518 + Commit restores the 4 cases
checks.detail: after reload list was empty (0 cases); begin ok; 518 chunk writes in 1153966 ms (19.2 min; per chunk about 1 s at the start growing to about 3-4 s per chunk after ~350 chunks, with 3 write retries after command timeouts that the idempotent retry rule accepted); commit ok in 14456 ms; total 1169081 ms (19.5 min); restored archiveRevision equals the exported revision sha256:2d751ce751478; caseList afterwards shows the same 4 names/kinds

checks.name: Comparison of write and read costs
checks.detail: Import write cost grew with staged size (progress per 50 chunks: 47.7, 66.3, 103.9, 99.8, 147.2, 114.6, 109.6, 201.2, 120.8, 107.3 s), consistent with page- or connector-side cost that is not constant per chunk; cause not diagnosed. n=1 on one machine; not a guarantee.

notVerified: 8-case large archive (only 4 cases of 8.48 MB were saved because caseSave 5-8 timed out)
Cases are four identical replicated results of one 1.0 mm structural solve, not four distinct physical results
Bytes/chunk numbers are single measurements (n=1); throughput is dominated by one loopback round trip per 64 KiB
Root cause of the growing import-write latency and of the caseSave timeouts was not diagnosed (page stayed responsive: caseList answered in ~11 s)
notes: Partial: round trip, hashing and revision identity at 33.9 MB are verified; the stated 8-case scale was not reached.
